meta.title: Which province each people group falls in — India and China
meta.why: Published so no other build has to repeat this point-in-polygon. gospel-internet ran the identical ray-casting over the identical geometry and could only check itself against our aggregates; a second implementation of the same geometry is a second place for it to drift.
meta.grain: one row per PLACED people group; the four that fall outside every polygon are in the aggregate file's `unassigned`
meta.agrees_with: gospel-by-province.json — per-province counts and the assigned total are reconciled at build time, and neither file is written if they differ
meta.approximate: Every row is approximate. The coordinate marks a PEOPLE group, not a settlement; its position is approximate, and near a border it can fall on the wrong side. No surface may present a province as a fact about a group.

rows.province: Dādra and Nagar Haveli and Damān and Diu
